UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Nime Watcher user profile, onboarding details, and preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in profile and greeting.

email.description: Private user email address visible only to the owner.

dateOfBirth.description: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD handled privately.

avatarId.description: Selected original anime avatar identifier, google_photo, or custom_photo.

customAvatarPath.description: Optional local app-internal path to cropped custom avatar image.

profileCompleted.description: Whether onboarding registration details were completed.

termsAccepted.description: Whether Terms of Service and Privacy Policy were accepted.

darkModeEnabled.description: Whether dark obsidian theme is active.

UserGenrePreference.title: UserGenrePreference
UserGenrePreference.description: Authenticated user's saved genre & tag discovery preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

preferredTags.description: Bounded list (max 25) of favorite anime genres or tags.

sortBy.description: Preferred sort order for genre-based discovery.

onlyShowPreferred.description: Whether to prioritize/filter shelves to the user's preferred tags.

DiscoveryCategory.title: DiscoveryCategory
DiscoveryCategory.description: Custom or curated genre/tag shelf category stored per user in Firestore.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Display name of the genre or tag category.

queryValue.description: Exact AniList genre or tag string used to fetch anime.

filterKind.description: Whether queryValue maps to AniList genre_in or tag_in.

accentKey.description: Visual accent theme key for the category card.

isPinned.description: Whether this category is pinned to the top of discovery.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and preferences owned strictly by userId.

/users/{userId}/genre_preferences/{prefe.description: User genre and tag discovery preferences owned strictly by userId.

/users/{userId}/discovery_categories/{ca.description: User-customized anime tag and genre categories for discovery shelves.
